name: Mujigi Balloon (Intelligence Increase)
description:
This balloon, shaped like a Mujigi, increases INT for 30 minutes.

**Note**
Can be used simultaneously with STR and INT increase balloons.
Cannot be used simultaneously with damage increase and damage absorption balloons.

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
